test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All books are papers.

All trees are papers.

All papers are recyclable.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some books are trees.

II. All trees are recyclable.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows
Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5137b8d8e832f421bcdc570bd6ba1db218fb7b5655a671eb27224fca044a6b3.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some books are trees → Does not follow (As all books are papers and all trees are papers. So it is possible but not true.)

II. All trees are recyclable → **F**ollow (As all trees are papers and all papers are recyclable. As whole trees comes in papers which whole comes in recyclable, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
